diagnostic_threshold_scope: Reporting only, not reader qualification. Require finite boundaries, segment counts and guarded-gap integrity separately.
finite_structure_display_gate: Positive R/P >= 90%, exact declared segment count, boundary bijection <= 25 mm, zero guarded gap false length; same-segmentation diagnostic only.
development_replay: All 184 inputs and prior scores have already been seen: five separate cohorts of 44 mixed, 36 section, 40 sampling, 32 support and 32 local-evidence conditions. No new generator, object or holdout is introduced. This is hypothesis-development replay.
parent_reference: Execute 368 fresh consensus rows; reuse 368 exact same-input/policy bundle_small normal references. Cached zero elapsed is not a speed benchmark.
freeze_policy: Verify all 1104 parent normal rows before separated truth copy. Freeze source/input/two-arm policies, then execute all 736 normal/reference rows before GT. No overwrites or post-score edits.
qualification: Development-only comparison after prior results were observed; no blind validation, foreground recognition, arbitrary topology, whole-scene improvement or G1. Keep every positive abstention, error and nonempty negative/unresolved output visible. Point-only representation pairs are identical-input checks, not independent physical evidence.
intervention: Preserve guarded bundle_small geometry and unchanged section ownership. Two fixed salted ridge partitions each fit/validate with unchanged physical/cadence/coverage/ambiguity policy; add only finite endpoint-matched segments emitted by both. Partitions overlap, not independent physical experiments. No seed search or averaging/extension. Existing overlapping members are not duplicated.
